name: Black and Blue
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

With a successful ranged touch attack, you cause the target to bruise easily. Each blow she takes from a bludgeoning weapon – including fists or bare hands – leaves an exceptionally large and painful bruise. In addition to the normal damage from the attack, the target takes 1d6 points of non-lethal damage from the bruising.
